notes.title: Cats and Sokoban - Mimi's Scratcher is here. Play it now!
notes.content:
[b]We are happy to announce our new release:[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/2c99195f7b3176193c4fdf25826de2da2b1fe7fd.png[/img]

Cats and SokoBan – Mimi’s Scratcher is a sokoban type game in which you can push boxes, stack boxes and even jump between platforms, when necessary, so that Mimi the cat can reach her scratching post and have fun.
Look the level carefully, there is no time limit, no resources to manage, so you can calmly focus on solving the challenges.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/6ad9e5774fefbe7dbfbd46aa7e47bc29070d1129.png[/img]

Our team loved making this game. Mimi is a cat owned by one of the staff members, she is very cute.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 50 handcrafted levels.
[*] Stack boxes.
[*] Catchy soundtrack.
[*] Jump between platforms, like a good cat would.
[*] Minimalist interface and gameplay.
[*] 12 backgrounds for you to choose which is pleasant;
[*] Restart level.
[*] Fun and sweet sokoban with relaxing.
[*] Mimi, the cutest one that will warm your heart ♥
[/list]

You can get it now at a good discount and play it for many hours:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222770/Cats_and_Sokoban__Mimis_Scratcher/

notes.title: Definitive Edition
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We came to announce the [b]definitive version[/b] of our game.

We have been collecting comments and conversations on all our pages and media and decided to update our game.

In this new version you can find some actions that have been improved mainly for notebook users.

[h2]New User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]We worked hard to find improvements that would suit different resolutions. We improved on-screen aspect ratio following UX rules.
[/list]
[h2]Phase optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*]Our game mixes still images with moving images; We were using an "old" way of merging these elements. We made necessary updates replacing this system and consequently having considerable improvements to all users.
[/list]
[h2]Sound Improvements[/h2]
We've had people claim to feel sleepy while playing the game. Our game is focused on relaxing people, we imagine that we are on the right path.
[list]
[*]However, we made a small speed increase in song composition and changed song volumes and gains. We recommend having a nice cup of coffee or tea from the main menu while enjoying the soundtrack.
[/list]
We appreciate the participation of everyone who gave their opinion on these improvements.

We will be waiting for your feedback on our community page, email or social media.

notes.title: Definitive version
notes.content:
Yes, we've made some updates to Invisible Services - Pixel art Jigsaw Puzzle!
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Project Optimization.
[*] Sound improvements.
[/list]
Improvements that are evident in [b]FPS gains[/b] and [b]stability[/b].

We are happy to bring these updates to you.
Don't forget to follow us on our social media and let us know what you think of the updates in the Community Center.

A safe hug for each one ♥

notes.title: Small Update! v3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] In this version, [b]visual feedback[/b] was added when the piece is fitted in place!
[*] The audible feedback of when a piece is picked up and another for when the piece is released have been modified.
[*] There was a problem saving the game sounds. [b]This problem has also been solved![/b]
[*] Some users felt that the pieces moved very slowly in relation to the mouse, we did a test with a focus group and we arrived at new values, we hope it will please you.
[*] Some achievements had a long wait to be called, we made changes to that.
[/list]

We hope this contributes to your experience!
[b]Make sure you follow our Studio developer page, so you can always stay on top of new games and news.[/b]

Enjoy this [b]relaxing experience.[/b]
[b]Make sure to tell us what you think! Our social networks or our Community Center![/b]
